name: woclaw-workspace
description: WoClaw - Shared memory and messaging hub for AI agents

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace=hub && npm run test --workspace=plugin && npm run test --workspace=woclaw-vscode --if-present && npm run test --workspace=woclaw-mcp --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=hub && npm run build --workspace=plugin
scripts.build:all: npm run build --workspace=hub && npm run build --workspace=plugin && npm run build --workspace=woclaw-mcp && npm run compile --workspace=woclaw-vscode
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --workspace=hub && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=plugin && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=woclaw-hooks && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=woclaw-mcp && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=woclaw-codex --ignore-scripts && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=opencode-woclaw && npm pack --dry-run --workspace=woclaw-vscode
